name: io.github.rithwikbabu/packwright-mcp
title: Packwright MCP
description: Local-first MCP server for creating, validating, testing, and packaging Minecraft Java datapacks.

environmentVariables.name: PACKWRIGHT_WORKSPACE
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the directory containing datapack projects Packwright may access.

environmentVariables.name: PACKWRIGHT_JAVA
environmentVariables.description: Optional Java 25 executable used for setup, vanilla command validation, builds, and GameTest runs.

environmentVariables.name: PACKWRIGHT_CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Optional absolute path for verified Minecraft artifacts and local reference data.

environmentVariables.name: PACKWRIGHT_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to disable MCP tools that write to the workspace.

environmentVariables.name: PACKWRIGHT_OFFLINE
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to prohibit network access, including explicit version setup.

environmentVariables.name: PACKWRIGHT_SPYGLASS_COMMAND
environmentVariables.description: Optional command for an independently installed and trusted Spyglass executable.
